actual.descripcion: A teenage girl wants revenge on the man who killed her father, but she needs help from legendary one-eyed marshal 'Rooster' Cogburn, and a Texas Ranger.

siguiente.descripcion: A former Union Army colonel sets out to settle some old scores and find the two Yankee traitors responsible for the loss of a gold shipment and the death of his best friend. His search leads him to a showdown in the town of Rio Lobo, where he finds a whole community under siege from their own sheriff and a mysterious landowner.
